name: farmer
concept: An old New England farmer met on the road outside Innsmouth: weathered, sunburnt, white stubble, a battered straw hat, patched flannel shirt, denim overalls, muddy boots, a pitchfork he is not carrying now.
description: Weathered sunburnt old farmer, white stubble, battered straw hat, patched red flannel shirt, blue denim overalls, muddy boots.
